title: Certify implemented capabilities in the bounded legacy engine backlog
description:
Aggregate certification for positive capabilities implemented from the bounded legacy
engine:F1-F10 backlog. Certification proves selected operations against source-faithful
inputs, provider-neutral execution, and state effects. It is a backlog milestone, not a
prerequisite for SRD re-freeze merely because other backlog entries remain unselected.
acceptance_criteria:
- Every capability counted as certified has a stable contract, real binding, provider-neutral execution, and correct state/replay behavior where applicable.
- Certification is scoped to selected/implemented operations; missing backlog capabilities remain backlog, not source absence.
- Family completion may summarize only the bounded legacy backlog.
- This bead does not gate re-freeze on zero engine-pending or universal deterministic support.
notes:
ADR-0020 authority reconciliation applied 2026-09-10 by eshyra-o9bd.19.6.5.
The operative title/description/acceptance criteria supersede contradictory
pre-ADR global-closure language in older notes. Historical notes remain evidence,
not current authority.
close_reason: RETIRE/SUPERSEDE (2026-10-09 rebaseline): duplicated ownership. Its blocking children (ten per-family certify tasks) were retired on 2026-09-23 without certifying anything, and its surviving responsibility - capabilities actually in force have a stable contract, real binding, provider-neutral execution and correct state/replay behaviour - is owned at the re-freeze boundary by eshyra-o9bd.19.5.12 (single in-force inventory with W13 contract fields) and eshyra-o9bd.19.6.3 (AC: 'Capabilities in force have current binding/execution/state evidence'; replay-where-applicable recorded there as absorbed from this bead). The edge olc5.2 -> 19.5.12 was removed as part of this retirement. The magic-item operation readiness capability (MAGIC_ITEM_OPERATION_READINESS_CAPABILITY) and the item economy executor (eshyra-c7sx) are in-force members covered by both. Unselected legacy backlog was never this bead's to certify. Hides no source/discovery/state defect: known capability defects have their own owners (eshyra-olc5.7).
